entry_hash.description: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 JCS of the entry WITHOUT the entry_hash field

mono_delta_ms.description: monotonic ms since previous entry; -1 = unknown (first entry after process start)

access_id.description: identifier of the access; an access spanning several data classes carries the same access_id in each of its entries

actor_id.description: account in the operator's account directory; a uuid cannot carry a name; every addition to the directory stands beforehand as an entry of its own (data_class credentials, access_mode change, purpose maintenance, scope all_customers) whose case record is the addition (heartbeat spec 12, access chain, item 4)

capture.description: gate: written by an access path through an import interface (origin import) before it released data (format spec 8.7); declared: entered by a person (origin portal); emergency: an access path released data without confirmation because the access chain was unreachable, and the person entered the access afterwards (origin portal)

data_class.description: follows the list 'Was der Hersteller hält' of heartbeat spec 12; chain includes the data of the vendor log and openings of fillers (format spec 7.4.13); access_chain is the access chain itself with its case records and salts (heartbeat spec 12), e.g. when an audit reads it; store is the whole data store (the file of a database, access to a machine); other is a class the case record names

purpose.description: service is the standing purpose of a service, recorded once per start of the service and per data class; only a part whose output no person reads directly counts as a service, every other part is an access path and writes one entry per access (heartbeat spec 12, access chain, item 1); other refers to the case record

record_commitment.description: Hex(HMAC-SHA-256(key = salt, message = case record)), salt 32 random bytes per case record; record and salt stay with the operator, never in the chain; the verifier does not check it (no evidence produced by LEDGER for the content of the record)

prev_hash.description: entry_hash of previous entry; seq=1: 64 zeros
